summary: ppa-navigation ships a bare-IP beacon that exfiltrates installer host identifiers at install and import time
details: The package is a non-functional shim whose only behavior is a reconnaissance beacon. The postinstall hook runs `node beacon.cjs`, and `index.js` also calls `fire()` at require time; both POST a JSON payload containing the package name, `os.hostname()`, the install path, `process.cwd()`, and the Node userAgent over plain HTTP to the hardcoded bare-IP endpoint `http://185.158.107.175:8787/_ah/dc` with an `x-beacon-package` header. `index.js` performs no real work and exports a Proxy that returns a no-op for every property access, so the module has no legitimate utility beyond calling home. The combination of a generic `Compatibility shim.` description, a hardcoded bare-IP collector over cleartext HTTP, and install- and import-time execution matches dependency-confusion/typosquat reconnaissance that leaks installer hostname and filesystem paths to a non-first-party destination for follow-on targeting.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
